question.value: Which complex organic molecules are present in each of the two protostellar cores A1 and A2 of NGC 1333 IRAS 4A, and what are their abundances and the chemical contrast between the cores?

evidence.quote: We aim to perform an interferometric study of multiple COMs in NGC1333 IRAS 4A, which is a protostellar binary hosting hot corino activity
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2013.1.01102.S.

bands.value: ALMA Band 6 (~250 GHz, 1.2 mm); PdBI 2.7 mm

evidence.quote: to observe IRAS 4A in Band 6 ($\sim 250$ GHz)

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 16 spectral windows between 244 and 264 GHz, 58.6 MHz bandwidth, 122 kHz (0.14 km/s) resolution

evidence.quote: We employed 16 spectral windows between 244 and 264 GHz, whose bandwidth and spectral resolution are 58.6 MHz (70 km s$^{-1}$) and 122 kHz (0.14 km s$^{-1}$), respectively.
A total of 35 antennas of the 12 m array were used
with a minimum and maximum baseline length of 18 m and 784 m, respectively
The baselines ranged from 32 to 400 m.
The resulting synthesised beam for the continuum image is $0.66'' \times 0.35''$ (P.A. $=$ $-29^\circ$).
the largest scale recovered by the array is 3.3$''$
the total integration time on-source was 26 min
was used on 14 June 2014, in its Cycle 2 operations
The PdBI was used on 29 January 2005 in its A configuration

evidence.quote: Continuum emission as well as five CH$_3$CN transitions at 110.4 GHz were observed.

findings_qualitative.value: All organic emission comes from A2; A1 is devoid of COMs even though it is the stronger continuum emitter.

evidence.quote: Molecular emission from organic molecules is concentrated exclusively in A2, while A1 appears completely devoid of COMs

claims.hypothesis: Does A1 lack COMs because dust hides a hot corino?
claims.experiment: Estimate the dust optical depth needed to hide a hot corino like A2's, using CH3CN at 2.7 mm and CH3CHO at 1.2 mm
claims.result: Required tau >3.2 and N(H2) >2.7e26 cm-2, implausible
claims.finding: The contrast is most probably real

evidence.quote: Thus, the significant contrast in molecular richness found between the two sources is most probably real.

claims.hypothesis: A2 has typical hot corino abundances
claims.experiment: Derived abundances compared with I16293, B335 and IRAS 2A

evidence.quote: This plot shows that A2 contains typical hot corino abundances that are comparable to those measured in the other three objects.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: A1 hot corino attenuated by optically thick dust, judged unlikely

evidence.quote: While such a large gas density is not totally impossible, it is highly unlikely.

limitations_admitted.value: Isothermal dust assumption is a simplification; A1 masses are lower limits

evidence.quote: We are aware that the assumption of isothermality is a simplification
